overview.historicalContext:
Erdős Problem #1144 concerns partial sums of random multiplicative functions. This problem remains OPEN.

Known results include: - **Atherfold (2025)**: Almost surely, ∑_{m ≤ N} f(m) ≪ N^{1/2} (log N)^{1+o(1)}. - #520: Variant with Rademacher multiplicative functions vanishing on non-squarefree integers.

This problem is catalogued at erdosproblems.com/1144.
